name: Dechang
legalName: Ningbo Dechang Electrical Machinery Made Co., Ltd.
legalEntityNote: Ningbo Dechang Electrical Machinery Made Co., Ltd. (宁波德昌电机股份有限公司, YDC) is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (605555) and based in Yuyao, Ningbo. It mainly makes vacuum cleaners and other small appliances for international brands, plus electric power steering (EPS) motors for car parts suppliers. Its products usually carry its customers' brands, not its own.
headline: Dechang: the Ningbo vacuum and motor maker for global brands
description: A source-backed profile of Ningbo Dechang (德昌股份): founder Huang Yuchang's family control, vacuum and small-appliance contract manufacturing, EPS motors for car parts suppliers, and 2025 and 2026 results.
metaDescription: Ningbo Dechang (德昌股份, 605555) profile: Huang family control, vacuum contract manufacturing, automotive EPS motors, 2025 and Q3 2026 results.
quickAnswer: Dechang (德昌股份, YDC) is listed in Shanghai (605555). Founder Huang Yuchang, his wife Zhang Liying and son Huang Shi control it.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is independent and is not affiliated with Dechang. Company-level disclosures do not establish which brands' products Dechang makes, or the legal manufacturer, factory, importer, seller or warrantor for any individual product.

ownership.summary: Ningbo Dechang Electrical Machinery Made Co., Ltd. is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (605555). Its third-quarter 2026 report lists founder Huang Yuchang (24.36%), Changshuo (Ningbo) Enterprise Management (20.08%), Zhang Liying (11.99%) and their son Huang Shi (6.00%) as the largest shareholders. Changshuo is owned 52% by Huang Yuchang, 28% by Zhang Liying and 20% by Huang Shi, and the three hold 21.20% of Dechang indirectly through family companies and partnerships. Dechang is the group head, so no separate parent company is listed.

productPortfolio.name: Vacuum cleaners and floorcare
productPortfolio.positioning: Dechang is a leading Chinese exporter of vacuum cleaners and carpet cleaners made for international brands, mainly sold in North America and Europe.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Products carry customers' brands; confirm the brand owner, legal manufacturer and warranty entity for each product.

productPortfolio.name: Small appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Personal-care and home-health appliances are Dechang's growth business, made for international brands.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm certification (UL, CE, CCC) for the exact model and market.

productPortfolio.name: Automotive EPS motors
productPortfolio.positioning: Since 2017 the subsidiary Ningbo Dechang Technology has developed brushless motors for electric power steering. Auto parts revenue rose 49.5% in 2025 to CNY 616 million.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Automotive customers named in Dechang's 2026 share-offering documents include Nexteer, ZF, JTEKT, Schaeffler and Continental.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dechang's strategy treats vacuum cleaners as its base business, small appliances as its growth business and EPS motors as its strategic business.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the producing site for each product and production run.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dechang's third-quarter 2026 report attributes falling profit mainly to higher raw-material prices and larger US dollar exchange losses; excluding currency effects, Q3 net profit was CNY 57.7 million, down 7.67%.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Export pricing may shift with raw-material costs and exchange rates.

marketsChannels.evidence: TTI is Dechang's largest customer. Dechang began supplying TTI with vacuum motors in 2007 and complete vacuum cleaners in 2012. A 2024 broker report said TTI accounted for more than half of Dechang's 2023 sales; industry sources consulted by World Clean Biz estimate the share at more than 80%.
marketsChannels.scope: Broker research citing company disclosures, plus a World Clean Biz industry estimate; Dechang's own reports reviewed here do not publish the exact share
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Products Dechang makes for TTI carry TTI brands such as Hoover and Dirt Devil in some markets; contact the brand owner for warranty.

marketsChannels.evidence: Dechang's products are made for international brands and sold mainly in North America and Europe.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Dechang does not sell under its own consumer brand in these markets; contact the brand owner for product questions.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Dechang (YDC) is one of China's larger vacuum contract manufacturers and depends heavily on TTI. A 2024 broker report put TTI at more than half of Dechang's 2023 sales; industry sources familiar with the business estimate TTI's share is now above 80%. Dechang has been adding customers such as SharkNinja and Helen of Troy, and its automotive EPS motor business is small but growing fast.

developments.title: Third-quarter 2026 results
developments.summary: Q3 revenue rose 11.11% to CNY 1.36 billion; attributable net profit fell 38.89% to CNY 31.3 million on raw-material costs and dollar losses.

developments.title: 2025 annual report
developments.summary: 2025 revenue rose 9.81% to CNY 4.50 billion; attributable net profit fell 60.40% to CNY 163 million. Auto parts revenue rose 49.51%.
